scope: Exactly one source and its source-local export subject; all supplied kinds and dates are considered, with explicit refusals. No cross-capture identity reconciliation.
as_of: Selected observations only; no inferred website as-of instant. Capture time is null.
repeat: Group full record_key. Exclude root provenance, observation_id, observed_at, part locators and the source extension row ordinal for evidence equivalence; every other field must agree. Select lexicographically smallest observation_id only within an equivalent group, recording all alternatives.
conflict: Quarantine every eligible observation of a disagreeing logical key. No manual override or newest-wins in version 1.0.0.
time: Non-temporal selection. Date-only/interval creation/update times are omitted with coarse_time_omitted. Exact >6 fractional digits or nanosecond precision refuse. Unknown maps to null.
text: No retained-text projection in this profile: exported lifecycle/completeness/dialect/embedded attribution are not established. Metadata-only deleted/removed/unavailable records are supported. Empty bodies are not manufactured.
parents: One known_identity reply_to maps through event alias even if target absent; unresolved target maps null with loss; conflicting parents refuse. Parent time stays null.
identity: AHIF:projection-record-key:1 and AHIF:projection-account-key:1 hash domains as frozen compatibility map
snapshot_identity: sha256 of AHIF:projection:1.0.0 newline + canonical {profile_sha256, selection, records, snapshot_without_id}; excludes paths, runtime receipts and bundle layout
coverage: sampled for deliberate projection, unknown temporal endpoints; no completeness percentage
limits: Unchanged AHAS defaults and actual schemas/loader; fail whole projection on a loader rejection
